sentences.en: At the helm of the cast of Underworld movie is actor Kate Beckinsale.

sentences.en: Two of the three films star English actor Kate Beckinsale.

sentences.en: The films were written and directed by Beckinsale's husband (they wed in 2006), Len Wiseman.

sentences.en: There are five main players in the cast of Underworld movie, beginning with its main star, Kate Beckinsale.

sentences.en: Kate Beckinsale played the lead role of Selene, who later learned that her entire family was murdered by the elder vampire Viktor, played by actor Bill Nighy.
sentences.vi: Kate Beckinsale đóng vai chính Selene, người sau đó được biết rằng cả gia đình cô đã bị sát hại bởi ma cà rồng lớn tuổi Viktor, do nam diễn viên Bill Nighy thủ vai.

sentences.en: In the film, Beckinsale's character, Selene, saves him from certain death as Lycans attacked him in his apartment.
sentences.vi: Trong phim, nhân vật của Beckinsale, Selene, đã cứu anh ta khỏi một cái chết nào đó khi Lycans tấn công anh ta trong căn hộ của anh ta.

sentences.en: Kate Beckinsale wears thigh high boots quite a bit in this one, released in 2004.

sentences.en: He has since married his star Kate Beckinsale, who has also appeared in such movies as Van Helsing, Pearl Harbor, and Much Ado about nothing.
